description: Election Commission - V. Naharani was Selected as a member of the Bathicaloa Municipal Council
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government council (Batticaloa Municipal Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for a local authority, including the nomination and declaration of a new member to fill a seat that became vacant. This falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7), which covers electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authorities.
